name: cisco-duo-mcp
description: Fix Duo MFA lockouts in one command and see every MSP subaccount at once, with signed Admin API calls.

cisco_duo_api_host.title: Duo API hostname
cisco_duo_api_host.description: Your Duo API hostname, e.g. api-XXXXXXXX.duosecurity.com (Duo Admin Panel > Applications > your Admin API application). For an MSP, use the parent account's hostname.

cisco_duo_ikey.title: Integration key
cisco_duo_ikey.description: Admin API integration key (ikey) from the same Admin API application.

cisco_duo_skey.title: Secret key
cisco_duo_skey.description: Admin API secret key (skey). Used only to sign each request; it is never sent to Duo.

cisco_duo_account_id.title: MSP subaccount
cisco_duo_account_id.description: Default customer subaccount for every call (account ID, or exact name from accounts list); a tool call that names its own account-id overrides it. Leave blank to act on the account the keys belong to; the fleet tools always cover every subaccount.

cisco_duo_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
cisco_duo_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 for a read-only server: lockout fix, phone-swap, enrollment chase, sync, import and export are hidden, and the API execute tool refuses every non-GET call. Leave blank for the full tool set.

cisco_duo_base_url.title: API base URL override
cisco_duo_base_url.description: Overrides the full API root (for a test server). Leave blank; CISCO_DUO_API_HOST is the normal setting.

cisco_duo_mcp_http_token.title: HTTP transport bearer token
cisco_duo_mcp_http_token.description: Bearer token that cisco-duo-mcp --transport http requires from every HTTP client (Authorization: Bearer). Leave blank for the default stdio transport, which Claude Desktop uses and which never reads it.

cisco_duo_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
cisco_duo_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Duo requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank unless you configured client profiles.
